items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: Doug has collaborated with vocalist Jean Carn, and with drummer Cindy Blackman, and trumpeter Wallace Roney.

ctx.x: Keyboardist and composer Doug Carn’s recording career began in 1969 and he has produced iconic recordings for the Black Jazz record label. Doug has collaborated with vocalist Jean Carn, and with drummer Cindy Blackman, and trumpeter Wallace Roney.
Doug was interviewed via Zoom on February 24, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
